gloss: to keep running; to continue running

definitions.gloss: to keep running; to continue running
definitions.explanation: To physically continue running without stopping, as in a marathon, a chase, or sustained exercise over a period of time.

definitions.gloss: to keep going; to keep pushing forward (figurative)
definitions.explanation: Used metaphorically to describe persisting in one's efforts, staying at the forefront, or continuing to strive toward a goal without giving up.

notes:
A compound verb combining ⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ (to run) with ⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (to continue). In its literal sense, it means to keep running physically. In its figurative sense, it means to keep striving or pushing forward, often used in motivational or inspirational contexts.

FORMS:
Ichidan verb ({走|はし}り{続|つづ}ける). Conjugates on the ⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ portion: {走|はし}り{続|つづ}けます, {走|はし}り{続|つづ}けた, {走|はし}り{続|つづ}けて, etc.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ~⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{走|はし}り{続|つづ}ける: to keep running (a course/path)
- ~⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かって→向かう：01186_mukau⟧{走|はし}り{続|つづ}ける: to keep running toward ~
- ⟦トップ→トップ：03862_toppu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{走|はし}り{続|つづ}ける: to stay at the top

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{走|はし}り→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧ — to run through to the end; emphasizes completing the course
- ⟦{駆|か}け→駆ける：14714_kakeru⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ — to keep dashing; more literary
- ⟦{歩|あゆ}み→歩む：13196_ayumu⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ — to keep walking forward; gentler metaphor
